Advanced Veterinary Care Center
Advanced Veterinary Care Center provides expert emergency & specialty veterinary care for companion animals in the heart of Broward County, South Florida. We are located in Davie, Florida, minutes away from Fort Lauderdale.
Our dedicated team of board-certified specialists and emergency clinicians provides compassionate, life-saving, and quality-of-life enhancing medical and surgical care for pets and their families.
We specialize in the accurate and timely diagnosis of life-threatening medical and surgical conditions, from emergencies to chronic issues. Our commitment to exceptional patient care extends to providing an outstanding client experience for pet parents. We collaborate closely with primary care veterinarians to ensure seamless communication, easy referrals, and a supportive culture within the veterinary community.
Every day, we strive for excellence in patient care and client satisfaction.

Animal Hospital in South Florida
Minutes away from Fort Lauderdale
AVCC is centrally located in Broward County, Florida, and is easily accessible from all major South Florida roadways. We are minutes away from Fort Lauderdale and are in the Pine Island Plaza, on the southwest corner of I-595 (State Rd 84) and Pine Island Road in Davie, Florida. AVCC is 10 minutes or less from I-95, the Florida Turnpike, the Sawgrass Expressway (State Rd 869), and I-75. We are approximately 12 miles from downtown Ft. Lauderdale, and 25 miles from downtown Miami or Boca Raton.
